checks.detail: P0 returned for 1 of 1 explicit danger cases.

checks.name: negated or hypothetical cases avoid P0
checks.detail: No P0 returned for 1 of 1 negative-control groups.

checks.name: contradictory or changing reports stay visible
checks.detail: The source-claim detector returned a conflict for 1 of 1 ground-truth changing-report groups. This detector check supplies the labeled memberships; it does not establish that automatic grouping joined those reports.

checks.name: incomplete reports remain reviewable
checks.detail: 1 of 1 labeled incomplete groups are unassessed or carry a review reason.

limitations: All reports and incident labels are synthetic; this small fixed test split does not establish operational accuracy.
Grouping metrics count report pairs; latency is per-report analysis plus incremental grouping on this process and hardware.
The lexical baseline uses token-set Jaccard similarity with simple zone/time gates; it is not TF-IDF.

The Jaccard and fixed-threshold cosine rows are diagnostic comparators, not production engine paths or calibrated probabilities. They use simple anchor-based zone/time eligibility and do not reproduce all production context, ambiguity, and review rules.
The diagnostic cosine threshold is fixed at 0.78 and was not calibrated or selected using this test split. Its context eligibility matches the Jaccard diagnostic.

Policy and conflict-detector checks use ground-truth group membership independently of predicted groups. Passing them does not imply successful automatic grouping; pairwise grouping errors and the real API workflow must be assessed separately.
The active Aegis engine used lexical/degraded mode; no semantic result is reported.
